## SK Square posts record profit as SK Hynix HBM demand drives Korea semiconductor results

Record profits flowing up through SK Square confirm that HBM demand remains robust at a financial results level, not just a design-win level; corroborates the NVDA revenue concentration data and supports continued HBM supply tightness assumptions.

- SK Square, the holding company parent of SK Hynix, reported record profit
- The record result is attributed to SK Hynix's performance, driven by HBM demand
- Headlines frame this as a broader Korea semiconductor demand signal, not just a holdco story
- Chosunbiz; single-outlet but specific in linking HBM demand to the profit record
